name: Calculus Interference and Base-N Hash Obfuscation
description: Replaces the state-restoration constraint with a continuous wave function whose third derivative at zero evaluates to exactly $s_u s_v (s_u^2 - s_v^2)$, which is zero if and only if $s_u = s_v$. Replaces the explicit lexicographical tie-breaker with a base-5 polynomial hash sum, forcing the model to deduce the equivalence to early-exit chronological backtracking.
